metrics.lacuna_counts_note: 1KI 2: spine = canonical 46-verse KJV enumeration; base=GG (GG transmits the more complete recension (GG 46v vs CAM 27v; shorter < 0.70x longer -> material extent split, spec-revision 2026-05-17 §3.3 clause 1). base=CAM remains the project decision of record (2026-05-17 GO). SURFACE-TO-USER: clause 1 selected a non-CAM base; flag for the user, never a silent flip (§3.3 clause 3).); witnesses' sense-objects mapped onto the spine by narrative content (never positional v==v); one-sided cells are class 'disagree' and counted in the (agree+disagree) denominator; lacuna = physical ⟦illegible⟧ only and excluded from every agreement denominator.

definitions.strict: exact literal token-string identity / (agree+disagree) aligned pairs
definitions.skeleton: diacritic/order-folded + near-homograph-folded token equality (class==agree) / (agree+disagree) aligned pairs, full aligned denominator
definitions.both_confident: skeleton-equal / aligned pairs where neither witness flagged that token uncertain or illegible (gap/insertion cells and lacuna rows also excluded from this denominator)
